issue.title: createField on D1 leaves an orphan field row when the column cannot be added
issue.body:
### Description

On D1, when `createField` cannot add the column (for example the collection table is already at D1's 100-column limit), the row it inserted into `_emdash_fields` stays behind. The field is listed in the schema but has no column, and retrying after freeing a column fails with `FIELD_EXISTS`.

Expected: a failed `createField` leaves no field row, so the field can be created once there is room. `createCollection` already guards against this ("so a failure in table creation doesn't leave an orphaned row", `packages/core/src/schema/registry.ts:563`).

Where (main 58e5f648):
- `packages/core/src/schema/registry.ts:1323` inserts into `_emdash_fields`, then `:1350` calls `addColumn`; the catch does not remove the row.
- `packages/core/src/database/transaction.ts`: on D1, `withTransaction` runs the callback without a transaction, so the insert is not rolled back.

### Steps to reproduce

Failing test (test only, no fix): https://github.com/marks-zyz/emdash/blob/repro/create-field-orphan-on-d1/packages/core/tests/workerd/create-field-column-limit-d1.test.ts

```
pnpm run --filter 'emdash...' build
cd packages/core && pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.workerd.config.ts tests/workerd/create-field-column-limit-d1.test.ts
```

Equivalent steps on a site: on D1, add fields to one collection through the admin or the schema API until the table has 100 columns (15 system columns + 85 fields). The next `createField` fails with `too many columns`, the field still appears in the schema, and creating it again returns `FIELD_EXISTS`.

### Environment

emdash `main` at 58e5f648 (2026-10-09), Cloudflare adapter, D1 (miniflare in `vitest.workerd.config.ts`). Not checked against the published 1.2.0 package.

### Screenshots

Not applicable.

### Logs / error output

```
FAIL tests/workerd/create-field-column-limit-d1.test.ts > createField at D1's column cap > leaves no field row behind when the column cannot be added
AssertionError: expected { …(18) } to be null
FAIL tests/workerd/create-field-column-limit-d1.test.ts > createField at D1's column cap > creates the rejected field once a column is freed
SchemaError: Field "overflow" already exists in collection "full_d1"
Tests  2 failed | 1 passed (3)
```

Found while checking EmDash against the tests of a CMS I built earlier on Workers (it had a test for this exact case). AI disclosure: the test and this report were prepared with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5); I ran the test myself on main and reviewed the text.
